description: This file defines a React functional component named 'KeyLifecycleSettings' responsible for rendering UI elements related to key lifecycle management, including key expiry settings and auto-rotation configurations. It handles user inputs for key expiry duration, auto-rotation toggling, and rotation interval selection, with support for custom interval entries.

classes.name: KeyLifecycleSettings
classes.description: A React functional component for configuring key lifecycle options such as expiry and auto-rotation.

methods.name: handleIntervalChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the rotation interval selection, toggling between predefined options and custom input.

methods.name: handleCustomIntervalChange
methods.description: Handles user input for custom rotation interval values.

methods.name: handleDurationChange
methods.description: Updates the expiry duration state and propagates the change to the form.
